none: PAS LIN-569B1C: LIN-569B1C: Roman radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [...]CVS P F AVG ; R/ LAETITIA AV[G]

An incomplete, worn and corroded Roman copper-alloy radiate of Carausius (286-293); 'LAETITIA AVG' reverse (Reece period 14). Uncertain mint. Chipped in several places, jagged edge. Obverse description: Radiate, draped bust facing right. Obverse inscription: [...]CVS P F AVG. Reverse description: Laetitia standing left with wreath and sceptre. Reverse inscription: LAETITIA AV[G]. Diameter: 20.00 mm; Thickness: 1.50 mm; Weight: 1.81g
